page: Testing Hono applications using Vitest framework. Basic testing pattern: create Request, pass to app, validate Response. Runtime-specific setup differs but steps similar. Cloudflare Workers: use @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers. Method: app.request(path, options, env). Test GET/POST/requests with various body types (JSON, FormData, Request instance). Headers: access via res.headers.get(). Status: check res.status. Body: res.text(), res.json(). Mock environment variables and bindings via env parameter. Testing helper for typed test client available. End-to-end testing approach. Questions: How do I test Hono apps? How do I pass environment variables? How do I test different request types? How do I check headers in tests?

sections.manifest: Request/Response testing pattern. Method: app.request(path, options, env). GET request: app.request('/posts'). POST request: app.request(path, { method: 'POST' }). JSON body: body: JSON.stringify({...}), headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }. FormData body: FormData.append(), pass formData as body. Request instance: new Request(url, options), pass to app.request(req). Response assertions: res.status, res.headers.get('name'), res.text(), res.json(), res.ok. Response headers customization in handler: c.json({}, 201, { 'X-Custom': 'value' }). End-to-end testing approach. Questions: How do I make GET requests? How do I send JSON? How do I test FormData? How do I check response headers?

Mock environment variables and bindings. Third parameter to app.request(): app.request(path, options, env). MOCK_ENV object structure: simple values (API_HOST), complex bindings (DB.prepare for D1). Useful for mocking Cloudflare Workers Bindings. Access in handler via c.env.VARIABLE or c.env.BINDING.method(). Enables testing without live bindings. Questions: How do I mock environment? How do I mock bindings? How do I access mocks in handlers?
